mainEntity.name: How do I make sure AI-generated educational content actually teaches something?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the materials are designed for learning rather than merely filled with text. Ask AI to create a clear objective, explanation, worked example, practice task, feedback prompt, and short check for understanding; then adapt each item to the learner’s level. Run My AI Biz’s course and presentation examples can support this structured workflow. Context: attractive slides alone do not prove that students understand or can apply the subject. Key factors: prior knowledge, cognitive load, pacing, examples, practice, feedback, and assessment alignment. Practical guidance: limit each section to one main idea, use speaker notes for explanation, and include an activity that reveals misunderstanding. Test the lesson with one learner or colleague before broad release. A focused workflow is easier to improve than a large package produced all at once.
acceptedAnswer.description: Build around a measurable objective, explanation, example, practice activity, feedback, and assessment. Match the reading level and prior knowledge, then test the lesson with a learner before wider use.
